name: A-Buffer Solid Voxelization
definition: A GPU-based solid voxelization technique that outputs a linked list of starting and ending voxels for each row and column in the voxel grid. It uses an A-buffer approach to handle multiple fragments per pixel by building and sorting linked lists of fragment data.
summary: A-Buffer Solid Voxelization is a GPU technique that voxelize watertight meshes by rasterizing them into a 3D grid and resolving multiple depth intersections per pixel using an A-buffer linked list structure.
